stories.title: Russia's MOEX Index Ends Flat as Stocks Slip
stories.summary: Russian stocks closed lower on the session, but the benchmark MOEX Russia Index ended little changed, Investing.com reports. The report gives no clear cause for the divergence.
stories.whyItMatters: Russian equity moves remain a niche signal for macro readers who track sanctions-era capital flows and commodity-linked stocks.
whatToWatch: The next session's MOEX close for a clearer direction
